caps.name: digit_classification
caps.description: Classify an 8x8 grayscale handwritten digit image (flattened to 64 pixel values in 0..16) into one of the 10 trained digit classes 0-9.
caps.failure_boundary: Requires exactly 64 numeric values in the 0..16 scale; other lengths or out-of-scale values (e.g. already-normalized 0..1 inputs) yield unreliable or invalid predictions. No rejection of malformed input is guaranteed.

caps.name: digit_probability_estimation
caps.description: Return the full class->probability distribution over the 10 digit classes for a 64-dim pixel-flattened input, enabling confidence inspection and ranking.

output_schema.description: Mapping of class label string (e.g. '0'..'9') to probability

caps.failure_boundary: Same 64-value, 0..16 input constraint as predict; probabilities are only meaningful for in-distribution digit images and may be overconfident on out-of-distribution inputs.

caps.name: pixel_saliency_attribution
caps.description: Compute input-gradient saliency for the predicted class and return the top-k most influential pixels, supporting explanation of which image regions drove the classification.

top_k.description: Number of top influential pixels to return

output_schema.description: List of top-k influential pixel entries (pixel index/value with gradient magnitude) for the predicted class

caps.failure_boundary: Depends on a valid forward pass to determine the predicted class; top_k must be between 1 and 64. Saliency is a local gradient heuristic, not a causal explanation, and is unreliable for out-of-distribution or malformed inputs.

caps.name: class_label_enumeration
caps.description: List the digit class labels the model was trained on, allowing callers to validate or interpret predict/predict_proba outputs.
caps.failure_boundary: Static metadata; fails only if frozen weights/state cannot be loaded.
